subject: Audit trail preservation capability declaration and harvest timeline
messages:
From: Emily Simmons <emily.simmons@harborbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@harborbank.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preservation capabilities + timeline for audit-harvest request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this RFP question. We need a short, definitive statement of Redwood's capabilities around audit trail preservation for procurement/legal review. Specifically, the reviewers want answers to:

- Maximum retention windows supported (per tenancy and per-route).
- On-demand harvest SLA (initial snapshot + incremental deltas).
- Delivery formats you support (schema and samples are helpful).
- Tamper-evidence/chain-of-custody controls (hashing, signing, certificates).
- Whether you can produce cryptographic manifests signed by your KMS/HSM and a verification procedure.
- Redaction options (PII removal or tokenization during export).
- Estimated cost and lead time for a full-year export (1TB compressed).

We have a legal hold window that may require complete fidelity + tamper proofing; please include any limitations (e.g., realtime streaming not retained beyond X days, protected PII exclusions, or egress constraints).

Can you send a short capability declaration and an example timeline by EOD Thursday?

Best,
Emily
Emily Simmons
Director, Legal Operations
Harbor Bank

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Simmons <emily.simmons@harborbank.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@harborbank.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preservation capabilities + timeline for audit-harvest request

Emily —

Appreciate the clear checklist. I attached a short capability declaration (redwood-preservation-declaration-v1.pdf) covering the items you listed and an outline timeline. High level answers here:

- Retention: configurable per-customer retention windows from 30 days to 7 years (policy-based). Default hosted retention is 365 days; Dedicated/Private can be configured to meet longer legal holds.
- Harvest SLA: standard initial bulk harvest: 5 business days from signed request; expedited (forensic/emergency) 24 hours with agreed process and cost. Incremental delta exports: daily snapshots within 48 hours; hourly deltas available for Dedicated customers.
- Formats: NDJSON (line-delimited JSON) and Parquet are supported. We provide a canonical schema mapping and a sample NDJSON bundle (attached). We can also produce CSV/NDJSON+schema pairing.
- Tamper evidence: every bundle includes SHA-256 manifests for each file and an overall manifest. Manifests are signed using our KMS-backed signing key; verification instructions are included in the declaration.
- KMS/HSM signing: yes — signatures are produced by HSM-protected keys; we provide certificate chain and verification steps.
- Redaction: configurable redaction pipeline (PII tokenization, field-level redaction or full-field suppression) with policy templates. Note: redaction is applied at export time; the raw auditstore retains full fidelity under default retention unless expressly redacted under a retention rule.
- Cost/lead time: rough estimate for 1TB compressed one-time harvest: $3,000 - $6,000 depending on format and whether expedited transfer (physical appliance / accelerated S3 egress) is required.

Attachments: redwood-preservation-declaration-v1.pdf, sample-ndjson-bundle.ndjson, forensic-manifest-blank.csv

We can follow up with a scoping call if you want concrete pricing and a delivery plan.

—Soogin Lee
Senior Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference

Soogin —

Thanks for the quick turn. A couple of clarifying Qs from Legal:

1) Does the SHA-256 manifest include per-record hashes or only per-file hashes? We need per-event hashes for tamper-evidence.
2) If Redwood signs the manifest, can Harbor obtain a certificate to independently verify signature provenance (root CA / cert chain)?
3) For incremental deltas: can you provide a change-log format (event id + prev_hash + new_hash) to stitch a verifiable timeline?
4) For redaction: can you provide both pre-export redaction and an auditable redaction map that shows which fields were suppressed/tokenized and why?
5) Is there an option for notarization: e.g., Redwood providing a notarized timestamp (third-party time-stamping) as part of handoff?

Please include the answers inline in the draft and let me know if something requires a Legal signature or acceptance of an addendum.

Emily

Quick ask: can Marissa confirm the manifest contents (per-record vs per-file) and the change-log structure? Jordan — confirm HSM signing process and whether we can produce a certificate bundle for customers to verify signatures. [Inline draft — do not forward externally until we align]
- Per-record hashing: Redwood can produce per-record SHA-256 values (field-level hashing optional) and include these in the NDJSON as a metadata attribute.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Simmons <emily.simmons@harborbank.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@harborbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preservation capabilities + timeline for audit-harvest request

Emily —

Thanks for the clarifying questions. Below are concise, definitive responses we are comfortable putting into contract language. If Legal wants different phrasing we can produce an addendum.

1) Per-record hashing:
- Redwood will produce per-record SHA-256 digests for each audit event included in a harvest. Each NDJSON event will include a top-level _digest field. Per-field hashing is available as an option but not enabled by default.

2) Signed manifests and certificate chain:
- Each delivery bundle contains: (a) file-level SHA-256 checksums, (b) a bundle manifest listing files + per-record digests, and (c) a bundle signature generated by an HSM-protected signing key. We will provide the signing certificate and the issuer chain (X.509) so Harbor can independently verify provenance. For Dedicated/Private customers we can sign with a customer-managed key upon request.

3) Change-log / incremental deltas:
- We will provide an incremental change-log format: {event_id, timestamp, action, prev_digest, new_digest, actor_id}. This enables stitching a verifiable timeline; deltas are produced daily by default and hourly for Dedicated.

4) Redaction map and audit trail of redaction:
- Exports can include a redaction-map CSV that lists record_id, field, redaction_method, redaction_reason, and a checksum of the redaction map. Redaction is a transformation applied at export time; the raw backed store is retained per your retention policy unless a separate deletion request is executed.

5) Notarization / third-party timestamping:
- Redwood supports optional third-party timestamping (RFC 3161) for bundle manifests. This is an add-on; pricing depends on volume — we quote per-bundle.

Delivery timeline and options:
- Standard bulk harvest (non-expedited): initial package in 5 business days, S3:// delivery (private bucket) or scp/SFTP.
- Expedited forensic harvest: 24 hours SLA after formal request + coordination call; additional fees apply.
- Physical appliance transfer (if requested): quote and timeline depend on logistics.

Formats and sample artifacts:
- Supported: NDJSON (canonical schema), Parquet. We attach a sample NDJSON bundle and a blank forensic-manifest CSV to show fields and structure.

Estimated cost for a 1TB compressed one-time harvest (US region):
- Standard: $3,500 (S3 transfer, manifest signing, standard packaging)
- Expedited (24h): $7,500 (priority processing + accelerated egress)
- Notarization add-on: $500 per bundle (approximate)

Next steps:
- If Harbor wants signatures on the declaration, we can produce a PDF addendum and provide both an electronic signature and KMS-signed manifest upon delivery.
- I'll set up a scoping call with Marissa/Jordan/Ben if you'd like to walk through a sample bundle.

Attachments included in this email: redwood-preservation-declaration-v1.pdf (signed capability statement), sample-ndjson-bundle.ndjson (sample events), forensic-manifest-blank.csv (field layout).

Please let me know if Legal needs contract-ready language for any item above and we will produce an addendum.

Best,
